name: SM_Jar_Storage_PR
supersedes: none (family 448 was placeholder: jar_vase 52, bowl 17 placements)
dresses: wheel-thrown storage jar, 0.51 x 0.74 m, rolled rim, brown lead glaze with throwing rings, runs, crazing and pinholes over a bare biscuit foot with a wavy glaze line; thrown out of true, hollow to a real inner wall

fit.colours: the sprite frames differ only in glaze colour: swap the material instance (MI_Prop_Glaze_Brown / _Blue / _Red / _Green / _Purple, all in materials.json) per frame
fit.sprite_scale: frames are 12-22 px wide (0.3-0.55 m at 0.025 m/px)

build: DINK_PP=<PhotorealPass> blender -b -t 4 --python Props/tools/props_bake.py -- <asset>; then blender -b Props/_build/Props.blend --python Props/tools/props_merge.py
status: round 2: unique bake, reviewed; not claimed photoreal where known_weaknesses lists faults
material_exception: unique bake (T_<Asset>_BC/_N/_ORM and _E where listed), private to this prop, not a row of ART_STANDARD.md section 2: the coordinator asked for sculpted or displaced high-detail sources baked to the game mesh with AO and curvature edge wear, true metal in ORM.B and emissive masks, which the shared tiling library cannot carry. Non-overlapping UV0; no vertex colour.
known_weaknesses: Round 2 unique bake, two review rounds (r6). Last look still faults: glaze runs are thin dark streaks, not thick beaded drips; chips at rim and foot are small; glaze colour is even around the body apart from throwing rings; no clear-coat layer (single specular lobe), the inside is glazed like the outside and falls to black.
